summary: Teaching spectral resynthesiser: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. One sample (Dye's five built-in ones, or your own WAV) is analysed once into its partials and its noise, then rebuilt at any key, speed and spacing: a stretch of the partials, a time smear, a freeze that holds one moment, a gate that keeps only the loudest partials and a balance between the tonal and noisy halves, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for frozen pads, bell-like stretches, ghostly textures and slowed-down sounds, or to learn how analysis-resynthesis works.
use_for: A teaching spectral synth: frozen pads, bell-like stretches and ghostly textures from one sample (built in or your WAV), analysed into partials and noise.

parameters.name: Stretch
parameters.description: Moves each partial away from its whole multiple of the pitch (+ spreads them apart, - bunches them), without changing the pitch of the note.
parameters.how: Moves each partial away from its whole multiple of the pitch (+ spreads them apart, - bunches them), without changing the pitch of the note.
parameters.sound: Positive values turn the sample bell-like, metallic and glassy; negative values make it dense, thick and clustered; 0% is the sample as recorded.

parameters.name: Time Smear
parameters.description: Averages the analysed partials over time (up to 300 ms either side), so that each moment of the sample drifts into its neighbours.
parameters.how: Averages the analysed partials over time (up to 300 ms either side), so that each moment of the sample drifts into its neighbours.
parameters.sound: Sharp attacks and movement smear into a liquid, washed-out blur; at 100% the sample is a slow cloud.

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Slows the reading of the analysis to a stop and moves where it starts to 40% into the sample; at 100% one moment of the sample is held for as long as the key is down.
parameters.how: Slows the reading of the analysis to a stop and moves where it starts to 40% into the sample; at 100% one moment of the sample is held for as long as the key is down.
parameters.sound: Turns the sound into a held, steady tone made of one instant of the recording; part-way it is the sample slowed down with its pitch kept.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Selects the recording that is analysed and played across the keyboard: Dye Essence's `Choir`, `Strings`, `Bell`, `Pluck`, `Texture`, or `User`, a WAV you load.
parameters.how: Selects the recording that is analysed and played across the keyboard: Dye Essence's `Choir`, `Strings`, `Bell`, `Pluck`, `Texture`, or `User`, a WAV you load.
parameters.sound: Changes the raw material every other control reshapes; each one has a different mix of partials and noise.

parameters.name: Partial Gate
parameters.description: Keeps only the loudest partials of the analysis: all 64 at 0%, a single one at 100%.
parameters.how: Keeps only the loudest partials of the analysis: all 64 at 0%, a single one at 100%.
parameters.sound: Strips away the weaker overtones, leaving a thinner, whistling or sine-like core; the noise is not touched.

parameters.name: Tone / Noise
parameters.description: Balances the two halves of the analysis: 0% plays only the noise, 50% both as recorded, 100% only the partials.
parameters.how: Balances the two halves of the analysis: 0% plays only the noise, 50% both as recorded, 100% only the partials.
parameters.sound: Left, the sample is a breathy, whispering wash with no pitch; right, a clean, pure, almost synthetic tone.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.

readings.description: The output's RMS over about half a second (-inf: silence)
The output's peak, falling 20 dB a second (-inf: silence)
Notes sounding now (unison voices belong to their note)

imports.description: A WAV sample (mono or stereo, up to 20 s, kept in the machine state with its analysis): the sample the Source control's User choice plays
